# dreamrouter_leases (Data Source)

Lists the router's current DHCP leases: which device has which address. Leases describe the network right now (expiry times change constantly, devices come and go), so use this for lookups, e.g. finding a device's MAC address to reserve it, rather than feeding changing values into resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# All current DHCP leases.
data "dreamrouter_leases" "all" {}

# Only devices that are online on one network.
data "dreamrouter_leases" "online" {
  network = "Default"
  status  = "online"
}

# Look a device up by host name and reserve its current address.
locals {
  tv = one([for l in data.dreamrouter_leases.all.leases : l if l.hostname == "tv"])
}

resource "dreamrouter_dhcp_reservation" "tv" {
  mac = local.tv.mac
  ip  = local.tv.ip
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `network` (String) Only return leases on the network with this name (case-insensitive).
- `status` (String) Only return leases whose device is "online" or "offline".

### Read-Only

- `leases` (Attributes List) Matching leases, sorted by IP address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--leases))

<a id="nestedatt--leases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `leases`

Read-Only:

- `connection` (String) "wired" or "wireless"; may be empty.
- `dns_name` (String) The device's DNS name (see dreamrouter_host); empty if none.
- `expires` (String) When the lease expires, as an RFC 3339 timestamp (UTC); empty if unknown.
- `hostname` (String) The host name the device sent with its DHCP request; may be empty.
- `ip` (String) IPv4 address the device has.
- `mac` (String) The device's MAC address, in lower-case colon form.
- `name` (String) The device's name: the one set in the web UI, else the router's name for it, else its host name.
- `network_id` (String) ID of the network the lease is on.
- `reserved` (Boolean) Whether the device has a DHCP reservation.
- `status` (String) "online" or "offline".
- `vendor` (String) Manufacturer, from the MAC address; may be empty.
